title: Close the full minimax value in the large-batch regime
statement: The target-query floor gives C*(d,m,eta)>=m. Accepted exact empirical histogram matching uses the ACTUAL old IID P^m rows and exactly m new IID Q draws, retains uniformly selected matching original indices and assigns residual labels uniformly. Its ENTIRE output law is EXACT Q^m and expected same-row changed fraction<=TV(P,Q)+sqrt((d-1)/m). Thus for EVERY m>=ceil((d-1)/eta^2), it meets the retention target with N_P=0,N_Q=m deterministically, attaining the lower bound: C*(d,m,eta)=m EXACTLY throughout this complete regime. All old-input reading/storage, sorting/matching, m-label output and expected finite exact tie/permutation bits are paid; this is not a deterministic local-bit cap or a practical speedup. It does not settle smaller batches or all logarithmic factors. Saving conditional-response work needs the prior response-independence assumptions, and does not remove the mandatory m target-label calls.

evidence.quote: ROOT THEOREM in the exact P1 batch model (fresh P/Q samples, actual X~P^m, exact ENTIRE Y~Q^m, unknown fixed laws, finite fair-bit computation/a.s. halting): EVERY universal exact-output algorithm has E_(P,Q)N_Q>=m for every fixed P,Q. No retention guarantee, deterministic cap, atom floor or exponential moment is needed for this lower bound. If mean is infinite the statement is immediate; otherwise:
evidence.range_scope: complete visible scientist return; no new Capital proof audit, source-original recovery or hidden-activity inference.

requires: Known finite alphabet [d], d>=2; integer m>=1 and rational 0<eta<=1/8. Fixed UNKNOWN laws P,Q, ACTUAL old IID archive X~P^m, and only independent opaque named P/Q sample queries plus fair bits. One distribution-independent program must halt almost surely with finite fair-bit computation and output the ENTIRE exact law Q^m for every pair. No probability/density evaluation, shared source seed, distribution-dependent advice, timing/identity access to the opaque oracle, or old Q-dependent side information. Query-floor theorem does not require a retention guarantee. Minimax C* additionally requires expected same-row changed fraction<=TV(P,Q)+eta.

assumptions: Only the large-batch regime m>=ceil((d-1)/eta^2) has the exact minimax value m. Full smaller-batch/all-log rate remains OPEN; max{m,C1-m+1} is a lower bound, not a matched universal rate. Do not multiply the one-record tolerant-testing lower bound by m; its transfer subtracts the m-1 newly acquired old-law records and retains its original asymptotic small-eta conditions/unknown constants. No atom floor, exponential moment or deterministic total-call cap is silently assumed in the target floor. Classical stopped change of measure/Wald/data processing is imported; ROOT explicitly derives the one-way absolute-continuity extension at degenerate Q rather than misapplying a mutual-AC lemma. Existing empirical matching and N1691/Dots/DDB1/SCC operations count once. No new implementation, independent audit, priority, discovery score or acquired practical advantage. Unknown-law source access is essential; known target probabilities/advice are different contracts. All source/access/ZIP/resource holds remain; no held original was retried or recovered.
costs: Count every NEW P/Q source query; the actual old m-record acquisition/storage/read cost and m-label output remain paid in full application/input accounting. Floor is E N_Q>=m pointwise in each fixed law pair, with infinite mean handled trivially. In the closed regime, N_P=0 and N_Q=m deterministically; exact uniform tie/permutation generation has finite EXPECTED computably bounded polynomial local bit work in m, log d, log m and complete rational-eta encoding, not a deterministic bit cap. The one-record reduction pays exactly m-1 additional P queries and expected finite exact-permutation bit work. Source query counts are not arbitrary-oracle wall-time bounds. Explicit list/output costs are not polynomial in log m while printing m records.
contract.units: Expected NEW named-source queries, exact ENTIRE product law, same-row mismatch and separately paid input/output/local-bit costs.
obstruction: The target-query floor and complete large-batch minimax regime are closed at their stated mathematical scope. Resolve the sharp smaller-batch/all-log minimax rate with matching paid algorithms/lower bounds. Response reuse can reduce expensive conditional-response work only under the existing independence contract; no real application advantage is established.

review.scope: Complete supplied Root proof/application of classical information theory and accepted empirical matching. No Capital scientific reproof, new independent audit, historical-priority finding or practical performance claim.
